tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Read FRW's published returns, exchanges, shipping, Style Pass, privacy, terms and package protection policies.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get a public FRW product or variant by its catalog ID. Prices match the product page in integer cents. Selected options narrow matches; preferences are relaxed from last to first. Unconfirmed availability is not in stock.

tools.name: get_reviews
tools.description: Read the same style-family review pool shown on the FRW product page, with borrowed-review attribution.

tools.name: list_jersey_templates
tools.description: List FRW custom jersey templates, editable print pieces, sublimation artwork modes, fonts, patterns, sizes and proposed USD volume tiers. Prices are nonbinding estimates pending factory costing; checkout and production are not enabled.

tools.name: list_scarf_templates
tools.description: List the FRW custom festival scarf (pashmina) template: two 25 x 72.25 inch printed panels sewn back to back, so front and back can differ. Returns panel size, safe edge, patterns, fonts, layer types, artwork rules and USD prices per scarf by quantity. Checkout is not enabled yet.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Look up up to 10 FRW product or variant IDs returned by this catalog. Unknown IDs return not_found messages.

tools.name: prepare_jersey_design
tools.description: Validate a complete jersey design and return a browser preview link and nonbinding merchandise estimate. Volume pricing applies per shared base design; 25+ requires a custom quote. Stateless: does not save a draft, create an order, charge money, approve artwork or send to production. Artwork is adde

tools.name: prepare_scarf_design
tools.description: Validate a complete festival scarf design and return structured issues, a browser preview link and the price estimate. Text layers are supported; artwork is uploaded in the browser studio. Stateless: does not save a draft, create an order, charge money, approve artwork or start production.

tools.name: quote_shipping
tools.description: Estimate guest shipping using country, merchandise subtotal in USD cents, and optional packed weight in grams. Final tax, duties, benefits and delivery timing are confirmed at checkout. No address needed.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search FRW's Prism catalog. Returns only variants confirmed buyable from live stock. USD prices use the product page sale rules. Cursor pages may be short after live stock filtering; has_next_page indicates further pages.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_reviews · Public sink: prepare_jersey_design.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_reviews · Public sink: prepare_jersey_design

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
